blurb: Ancestry Brewing is a brewery and restaurant owned by fifth-generation Oregon farmers Aaron and Erika Wilcott. They grow filberts, pumpkins, berries, and nursery stock on their family farm. The brewery offers a welcoming environment for families, friends, and teams to gather and enjoy craft beer, food, and house-crafted sodas.
